briefdescription.para: This file implements a CFG sorting pass.

detaileddescription.para: This pass reorders the blocks in a function to put them into topological order, ignoring loop backedges, and without any loop or exception being interrupted by a block not dominated by the its header, with special care to keep the order as similar as possible to the original order.
